feature_computation.net_charge: Henderson-Hasselbalch net charge at pH 7.0 using side-chain pKa (K 10.5, R 12.5, H 6.0, D 3.9, E 4.1, C 8.3, Y 10.1) plus N-term pKa 9.0 and C-term pKa 2.0
feature_computation.hydrophobic_moment: Eisenberg hydrophobic moment assuming alpha-helix, 100 deg/residue, normalized by sequence length
feature_computation.proline_fraction: fraction of residues equal to P
feature_computation.glycine_fraction: fraction of residues equal to G
feature_computation.cysteine_fraction: fraction of residues equal to C
feature_computation.hydrophobic_fraction: fraction of residues with positive Kyte-Doolittle value

ensemble_architecture: VotingClassifier(voting='soft') over RandomForestClassifier + XGBClassifier + Pipeline(StandardScaler -> LogisticRegression), one independent ensemble instance per target

training_data.cleaning_filter: sequence non-null and fullmatch [ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY]+; labels derived from 'T'/other flag columns migration_dominant and proliferation_dominant
